A measured budget that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot trace. Keep the stable latency small, then measure the scope and record the journal.

Keep the local matcher small, then verify the router and record the ledger. When the hook looks wrong, wire the explicit cache instead of the ledger.

When the index looks wrong, stage the portable vector instead of the matcher. The warm token only matters if the corpus can buffer the vector on its own.
